# NECB coverage across the openstudio-* gem family

Rollup of every gem's NECB `article_coverage` manifest (both vintages;
2020 refs are canonicalized to 2025 numbering — 2020 8.4.4.x -> 8.4.5.x,
the 2025-only 8.4.4 EUI subsection is never merged into). Statuses: **implemented** /
**partial** (warns every run) / **not_implemented** (warns every run) /
**satisfied_by_clone** / **host_scope** (delegated to the umbrella or a
sibling gem). Each domain gem emits its section of this accounting into
the shared AuditLog on every run, so nothing is silently missed —
EXCEPT openstudio-necb (the umbrella), whose entries are declaration-only
until it gains a runtime emitter: its partial/not_implemented rows do NOT
yet warn on every run.

| Gem | Vintage | Article | Title | Notes |

| openstudio-hvac | 2020, 2025 | 8.4.4.6. / 8.4.5.6. | Purchased Energy | Purchased HEATING is represented by a gas-fired boiler (energy type = gas, sentence (1)(a)); purchased COOLING forces an air-cooled electric chiller (sentence (2)(a)) via the chw_source config. — Gaps: Capacity-ratio clauses (1)(b)/(2)(b) are sizing-time and not enforced; purchased SHW (3) is host-scope. |
| openstudio-hvac | 2020, 2025 | 8.4.4.9. / 8.4.5.9. | Heating System | System per Table -A (1); purchased energy (2); energy type follows proposed (4); boiler plant staging 176/352 kW incl. modulating flow mode + 25% floor and HWST 82/60 reset conventions applied via plant defaults + efficiency pass (6). Furnace staging (7) IS modelled since D-46: gas-heated reference systems 3/4 build as an AirLoopHVACUnitarySystem holding a multi-stage gas coil (the Table -13 ASHP holds multispeed DX coils on the same machinery), and a post-sizing pass sets the stage COUNT from the sized capacity (two equal stages at or below the threshold, ceil(kW / stage size) above it) with every stage capacity left AUTOSIZED - the equal increments come from the unitary's multispeed flow ratios, so capacity auto-iteration still works. Terminal/secondary split (3) accounted for systems 1/2/5 via Sizing:Zone dedicated-outdoor-air accounting with a neutral supply-air strategy (D-50): the terminal is sized on the space load alone and the make-up-air unit carries ventilation at system level. — Gaps: Multi-energy capacity ratios (5) are not modelled. (7): electric-resistance heating is not a furnace so it is not staged (D-49), zone-terminal and make-up-air DX/furnace equipment stays single-stage (D-48), and a system needing more than four equal stages is CLAMPED at four with a shouted audit warning because EnergyPlus multispeed objects cannot hold a fifth stage (D-47). (3): systems 3, 4 and 6 mix outdoor air into the supply stream, so their split is only approximated by ordinary mixed-air zone sizing with baseboards taking the residual - audited as an approximation, not claimed. |
| openstudio-hvac | 2020, 2025 | 8.4.4.10. / 8.4.5.10. | Cooling Systems | System per Table -A (1); purchased energy (2); energy type follows proposed (3); chiller plant: 2100 kW split, 7 C CHWST, 25% modulating floor (6) via plant defaults + efficiency pass. DX staging (8) IS modelled since D-46 on the same machinery as the furnace staging of the heating article: multispeed DX cooling inside an AirLoopHVACUnitarySystem on reference systems 3/4 and the ASHP, stage COUNT set post-sizing from the sized total, stage capacities AUTOSIZED, efficiencies and curves binned by the TOP-stage (= total) capacity and applied to every stage. Terminal/secondary split (7) accounted for systems 1/2/5 via Sizing:Zone dedicated-outdoor-air accounting (D-50). — Gaps: Multi-energy capacity ratios (4) are not modelled. (8): zone-terminal DX (packaged terminal units cannot host a multispeed coil in EnergyPlus) and make-up-air tempering DX stay single-speed (D-48), and stage counts above four are CLAMPED at the EnergyPlus ceiling with a shouted warning (D-47). (7): systems 3, 4 and 6 have no separate ventilation stream, so their split is approximated by mixed-air zone sizing and audited as such. |
| openstudio-hvac | 2020, 2025 | 8.4.4.11. / 8.4.5.11. | Cooling Tower Systems | Tower cell count (1750 kW rule) and fan power set from chiller heat rejection in the efficiency pass. Tower design temps 35/29 C water, 24 C wb ARE set by the builder; cells per (2)-(3) with true ceiling; fan at the Table 5.2.12.2 0.013 kW/kW maximum. — Gaps: Fan cycling to the 29 C setpoint relies on CoolingTowerSingleSpeed default capacity control; pump is variable-speed hardware modeled with constant-power coefficients pending the constant-speed pump ruling (T-list). |
| openstudio-hvac | 2020, 2025 | 8.4.4.12. / 8.4.5.12. | Cooling with Outside Air (economizers) | air economizers (Table -12 -> 5.2.2.8) applied to reference systems 1/3/4/6 + HP with mechanical cooling: DifferentialEnthalpy control, up to 100% OA. Systems 2/5 get the 5.2.2.9 WATER-side economizer since D-56: a HeatExchangerFluidToFluid between the condenser and chilled-water loops, UA and both design flows autosized at sizing factor 1.0 (sized for the loop's full design cooling load), CoolingSetpointModulated onto the loop design exit temperature, plus the condenser setpoint reset to the outdoor wet-bulb + tower approach without which the tower stays at 29 C and the economizer is inert. Sentence (1) (wet-bulb 7 C) binds because the reference rejects heat evaporatively; (2) is declared inapplicable rather than ignored. — Gaps: DX staging clauses 5.2.2.8.(4)-(5) are not enforced. The 5.2.2.9 capability is realized as an INTEGRATED economizer against the prescribed 7 C chilled-water setpoint: measured hour by hour it carries 100% of the chilled-water load in every hour at outdoor wet-bulb 7 C or lower (the sentence-(1) criterion), and a partial share above that band; systems whose chilled water is air-cooled or purchased have no evaporatively-cooled fluid to economize with and are warned instead. |
